description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which represents a logging target or chain component within the Android logging framework. It declares a method for logging messages with associated metadata and optional exception details.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component that outputs log data to one or more targets, supporting chaining and filtering.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, optional Throwable, potentially propagating the log through a chain of LogNode instances.
